start_here: Say to your AI: "List the sources my tools come from, add an API description or tool server for my account, edit it or remove it", with {}. It runs tool:manage-my-tool-sources and answers {"every_account":[],"yours":[],"kinds":[]}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (tool-source, tool-source-change) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "List the sources my tools come from, add an API description or tool server for my account, edit it or remove it", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:manage-my-tool-sources and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: An empty request lists current default sources and this account's own sources.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: tool-source (records:read, records:list, records:write); tool-source-change (records:read, records:write).
